SELECT s.School, s.DOC
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS f2
      INNER JOIN schools AS s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2, s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM satscores AS t
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.Charter = 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.City

SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.AdmEmail2
FROM schools AS s
WHERE s.County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.DOC = '54'
  AND s.SOC = '62'
  AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS max_ratio
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN satscores AS t ON f.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE 1.0 * t.NumGE1500 / t.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30

SELECT f.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN satscores AS t ON f.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND t.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT t.sname, f.`Charter Funding Type`
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN satscores AS t ON f.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE f.`District Name` LIKE 'Riverside%'
  AND t.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT f.`School Name`, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800

SELECT s.School, t.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31'
   OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'

SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS ratio
FROM frpm AS f
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM satscores AS t
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE t.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND s.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT f.CDSCode
FROM frpm AS f
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT s.CharterNum, t.AvgScrWrite,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank
FROM satscores AS t
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE t.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
